business_summary: Fukoku Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells rubber, metal and synthetic resin, and bio and medical related products in Japan, Southeast Asia, India, the United States, Europe, China, South Korea, and internationally. It operates through the Functional Products Business, Anti-Vibration Business, Life Sciences Business, Metal Processing Business, and Hose Business segments. The company offers wiper blade rubbers that are used in automobiles, railways, ships, and aircrafts; and seal products, which are used in automobiles, pneumatic devices, and industrial machinery. It also provides anti-vibration products comprising suspensions, rotating systems, and engine accessories for automobiles; shock absorbers and railroad track pads for railcars; and construction and industrial machinery. In addition, the company offers standard, semi-custom, and nonmagnetic ultrasonic motors; and ultrasonic atomizer products. Further, the company provides cell culture bag products; OA-related products, such as digital photo printer rollers and pads, and ink jet printer components; urethane products and microchannel chips; dampers, mounts, and urethane; metal parts for trucks and construction machinery; and hoses and other rubber products. The company was formerly known as Fukoku Rubber Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Fukoku Co.,Ltd. in January 1986. Fukoku Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.
